//: A typecheck for scripts/ THAT CAN ACTUALLY FAIL.
ROUND 3 P0-1 shipped because nothing typechecked this directory. My attempts returned exit 0 with zero
scripts/ diagnostics, which I read as 'clean'. They were not clean: tsc aborts on PARSE errors inside
node_modules/@solana/spl-token-group's bundled codecs .d.ts (a TS-version mismatch), and skipLibCheck
does not suppress parse errors. So tsc never reached scripts/ at all and reported success.
`paths` maps that one package to a stub so the parse error cannot abort the run. That is narrow and
targeted: everything else is still checked for real.
